The '''Gibad system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Abrion sector/Legends|Abrion sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The system contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gibad/Legends|Gibad]].
